# dataversecontact_table_definitions (Data Source)

Lists all table definitions (published and built-in) for a scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dataversecontact_table_definitions" "default" {
  scope = "default"
}

output "table_count" {
  value = length(data.dataversecontact_table_definitions.default.definitions)
}

output "table_names" {
  value = [for d in data.dataversecontact_table_definitions.default.definitions : d.route_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope` (String) The scope to list table definitions for.

### Read-Only

- `definitions` (Attributes List) List of table definitions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definitions))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--definitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definitions`

Read-Only:

- `dataverse_logical_name` (String) The Dataverse entity logical name.
- `dataverse_table` (String) The Dataverse OData entity set name.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `field_count` (Number) Number of fields defined.
- `primary_key` (String) The primary key field name.
- `required_permission` (String) The base permission name.
- `route_name` (String) The table's route name.
- `source` (String) The source ("published" or "built-in").
